copy.tagline: 在 Cursor 中完成本地或远程的记忆服务配置，让 AI 助手记住上下文。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在 Cursor 里编程，希望 AI 助手能跨会话记住内容。
copy.tagline_en: Set up a memory service for Cursor with local or remote options.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you code in Cursor and want your AI assistant to remember context.

howto.what: 在 Cursor 上装好 claude-mem 后,它会启动一个本地 worker,并带上自带的 hooks 和一个 MCP 服务,让 Claude 通过它工作。也可以改成连远程 worker,由 cmem.ai 或你自己的服务器做推理。
howto.when: 当你要在 Cursor 上安装 claude-mem 时触发,涉及选择本地或远程 worker、本地主机登录或远程 cmem.ai 推理等配置。

say.text: 帮我在 Cursor 上装 claude-mem,用本地 worker
让 claude-mem 用本地主机登录模式

howto.what_en: After installing claude-mem in Cursor, it starts a local worker and attaches its bundled hooks plus an MCP server that Claude talks to. You can instead point it at a remote worker using cmem.ai or your own server.
howto.when_en: Use when setting up claude-mem on Cursor: choosing a local or remote worker, and local host-login observer versus remote cmem.ai inference.

say_en.text: Install claude-mem in Cursor with the local worker
Switch claude-mem to a remote worker at https://myhost
Set claude-mem to local host-login mode
